task: Implement WP1, the shared framework-neutral core extraction, on existing branch migration/svelte-shared-core. This branch was created from PR #578 head cfa9f9eebdf6bd7d78c6563fcb03e51bbeef02fa specifically for an independently reviewable PR back into migration/svelte-cypress-hard-cut. Read CLAUDE.md, docs/development/v3-application-stack-decision.md, the current React and apps/web package/workspace/test configuration, and the Planner & Review migration intent embodied by issue #580. Inventory dependency closures before moving files. Create repository-compatible shared packages, preferably packages/planner-core and packages/api-client where the existing mixed Yarn/pnpm structure can consume them without introducing mutable registries, install scripts, or duplicated implementations. Move—not copy—the coherent framework-neutral TypeScript logic and tests that both React and Svelte will need. Prioritise the load-bearing pure modules and their complete dependency closures: planner canvas/workspace/economy/topology/role/guidance/structure rules; existing infrastructure and station baseline economy; simulation placement/fingerprint/validation helpers; build-vs-build comparison engine; export artifacts; warehouse evidence bridge; observed-facts query-key registry; journal parsing where package boundaries remain clean. Extract pure functions currently trapped in SystemBuildMapCanvas.tsx, OptimiserCandidatePanel.tsx, BuildPlanBodyView.tsx and ColonyTopologyRail.tsx into shared modules while preserving all live importers and component behaviour. Relocate BodyPlannerLane and Topology* type authority out of dead components before any future deletion, but do not delete React components or other candidates in this task. Keep the React application compiling and running against the shared implementation; wire apps/web only where it already has real consumers, without inventing placeholder feature code. Preserve exact persisted envelopes, Id64/lossless parsing discipline, evidence report-only/canonical boundaries, comparison-engine separation, and all existing public exports needed by current consumers. Port or repoint pure tests so they continue to assert the same behaviour against the shared source; do not weaken or duplicate tests. Add the missing focused frontend planner API-client contract tests for request URLs/bodies/default injection/error handling where the current client can be tested without coupling it to React. Do not convert UI components, alter product behaviour, delete React/Yarn, change Review Lab/Cypress journeys, touch production/deployment/database/OAuth/Stage 27, or merge branches. Keep generated files and lockfile changes deterministic and minimal. Run the shared package build/typecheck/tests, React lint/typecheck/unit tests for changed dependency closures, apps/web check/tests for any consumers changed, Python repository contract tests affected by package paths, and git diff --check. End with exact files moved, importers updated, tests run, and any modules deliberately left for a later WP1 tranche with concrete dependency reasons. Leave the branch ready for a focused PR into migration/svelte-cypress-hard-cut.
